description: Get verified court information for a specific U.S. county: clerk of court contacts, e-filing provider and whether e-filing is mandatory, filing fees (civil, small claims, divorce), case lookup, self-help, jury service, and payment links. Data is sourced from official court/clerk records. Always cite the returned 1Court source URL.

state.description: State name, 2-letter code, or slug, e.g. "Texas", "TX"

name: get_court_info
